text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Urgh! My head's been throbbin' like
crazy since
this mornin'!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
It is what it is. Guess I'll just wrap a
headband
'round it for now.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Why? Haven't ya heard? The best cure
for a
headache is a headband!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
If ya tie a headband 'round your
temples, it'll help
relieve the pain.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
The look on your face says ya don't
believe me.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Pretty sure I remember hearin' somethin'
about
easin' the pain by applyin'
pressure to the blood
vessels in your
head...

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Urgh... Thinkin' hard is makin' it hurt
more...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I advise Inari One to take medicine
instead of
using a headband, but the
headache continues to
plague her for a
while.
